subQuests.subQuestName: Listen in on the Arataki Gang's discussion

727300201.text: C'mon, Boss, you can't just let this one slide!

727300202.text: You've painstakingly built up a reputation as the "Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King." You can't let that brat get away scot-free!

727300203.text: Yeah! That little punk must have used some underhanded trick to catch you off guard, I just know it!

727300204.text: Hey, hey, chill, boys, chill. Relax!

727300205.text: I just underestimated my opponent. And can you blame me, with how boring the kid looked? So yeah, no worries, that fight didn't count!

727300206.text: Anyway, enough about that. We're gonna stick to the plan, alright? The "Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl" is going ahead. Then, we'll bring out "Crimson Staff." Y'know, the one I've been training for years!

727300207.text: Just imagine it. The whole audience cheering me on as Crimson Staff gets ready to crush its opponent...

727300208.text: That kiddo will be trembling with fear. No tricks this time, no sir — just an easy win for Itto! Ahahahahahaha!

727300210.text: But we don't know when Shinobu's coming back. Where do we even start with organizing the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl?

727300211.text: Based on our experience with the Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, we'll need to register the event with the Tenryou Commission and obtain a permit... and I think we also need proof of a venue rental.

727300212.text: We're going to need to pay for all of that stuff somehow. If we want the Extreme Brawl to be even more extravagant than the Drumalong Festival, we'll need to spend at least three times the Mora...

727300213.text: Stop, stop, stop! We don't say "Tenryou Commission," out loud, okay? It gives me migraines!

727300214.text: So we need some funds, huh... Easy — just need to tweak our three-day weekend policy. As well as our one-day week policy. Let's work flat out and do two days on, four days off! That way, we work an extra four days between us, which means we'll earn four times as much. We'll be raking in the Mora!

727300215.text: Amazing, Boss! Then all we need to figure out is how to make up the numbers for our team! And it doesn't matter who we pick, because you're practically a one-man army!

727300216.text: ...Shoot, that's right! That brat said that he'll be bringing five of his top guys to fight us fair and square. But Boss, you're the only one in our gang who's any good at beetle fighting...

727300217.text: If they come at you in waves, you're gonna have a hard time no matter how good you are!

727300218.text: Come on, you two! It's a little early to be getting cold feet. You're thinking too many steps ahead.

727300219.text: Where's your Arataki Gang attitude? Come on, I'll find a way to deal with this, easy-peasy lavender-melon-squeezy!

727300220.text: Maybe I can hit up my usual beetle-fighting crowd... Or maybe I can visit Naganohara Fireworks and see if I can rope that gal into it...

727300221.text: ...Scratch that. If I did that, then news of me losing to that brat would spread around Hanamizaka! Ugh. My reputation would never recover...

727300222.text: True! So, Bull-Chucker, what are you up to this time?

727300223.text: Gah! You scared me! When'd you get here?

727300224.text: Seriously? We've been standing here for ages!

727300225.text: We were heading to the Adventurers' Guild, but then we saw you causing a commotion and talking about your next hare-brained event idea...

727300228.text: Hey, hey, hey! Don't forget the "Extreme" part. Can't do without the coolest bit of the name, y'know?

727300229.text: Compadre, you'll understand my passion for beetle fighting eventually. You just need more practice!

727300230.text: Ahh, so you're looking for a way to recover your pride after a humiliating defeat, are you?

727300231.text: What? No! Come on, it's not like that! I was ambushed! Ambushed, I'm tellin' ya!

727300232.text: That's right. Some poser calling himself "Grandmaster Hanakado" challenged the Boss in a brief moment of exhaustion after an intense beetle battling session.

727300233.text: He used a ridiculously huge Onikabuto and flipped Boss's beetle over in a matter of seconds.

727300234.text: And then he said something like, "Welcome to the world of real beetle-fighters"...

727300235.text: Mamoru, Mamoru! Easy on the details, my dude!

727300236.text: I think I understand the situation now...

727300237.text: Anyway, compadre, I've heard that you're talented at pretty much everything. You pick up new skills almost instantly, and before you know it, you're a pro...

727300238.text: Paimon knows what you're going to say next, Bull-Chucker!

727300239.text: You're going to ask us to avenge you and defeat that "Grandmaster Hanakado" for free, aren't you?

727300240.text: For free? Flying Lavender Melon, do you really think that I, Arataki Itto, have no code of honor?

727300241.text: Listen, compadre. If you do this for me, I'll buy you both lunch for the next two months. One bowl of signature ramen every day for two whole months! How's that sound?

727300242.text: One bowl every day? Ooh, now that's an offer worth considering...

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the grounds where the "Extreme Beetle Brawl" will take place

727300401.text: Not bad! Mamoru and Akira have delivered the goods. Let's start setting this baby up!

727300402.text: The highly experienced construction crew builds the arena...

727300403.text: Hahahahahaha! Now this is what I call an arena! Lookin' prett-ay good!

727300404.text: Boo yeah, compadre! I didn't know you were so handy with this kind of thing!

727300405.text: And this awesome poster I made is the cherry on top! It captures the mood perfectly! Ahahahahahaha!

727300407.text: This place seems pretty far from Inazuma City. You sure anyone's gonna show up to watch?

727300408.text: You bet they will! When you're as famous as I am, people will flock to watch you!

727300409.text: I heard this is the spot where they held the sword-fighting contest during the Irodori Festival. That makes this the ideal venue for Onikabuto duels!

727300410.text: Next up, time to show you my invincible Onikabuto, "Crimson Staff."

727300411.text: Oh, it really is a red Onikabuto! Amazing!

727300414.text: Huh. Paimon didn't expect you to put in this much effort. Where did you find this Onikabuto, anyway?

727300415.text: Can Paimon take a closer look?

727300416.text: Haha! Go ahead, feast your eyes! But I'm afraid I can't tell you what makes Crimson Staff such a special specimen. That's my little secret!

727300417.text: Huh? That smells so familiar, what is that... wait, Valberry Jam?

727300418.text: What! You're imagining things! You must be, like, super hungry, or something!

727300419.text: Speaking of which, Boss, you haven't applied a protective coating on top of the war paint yet, right? If it rains, then the 9,000 Mora we spent on the imported jam is gonna go to waste...

727300420.text: Don't worry! The "Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl" hasn't started yet. There's still time to give Crimson Staff one last layer of protective coating.

727300421.text: Alright, you guys go grab some flyers and start bringing in the crowds. In the meantime, I'll be helping my compadre and Flying Lavender Melon here get up to speed.

727300422.text: After that, we'll celebrate over a meal. Ah, so much going on, I've really got my work cut out for me today, whew...

727300423.text: This your venue? Not bad... bigger than I expected.

727300425.text: Wait, what? You're not supposed to know about this place yet!

727300426.text: Aren't you forgetting something, Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King? We elite beetle fighters can sense each other's presence... or how else would we have crossed paths last time?

727300427.text: Looks to me like you're still busy frantically preparing... is that because you don't have a clue how to beat us?

727300428.text: Pff! N—No...! Uh... In case you didn't know, me and my Onikabuto gotta get our brainwaves in sync before a battle, and until we're ready to roll, I always conserve my energy and keep a low profile!

727300429.text: I just underestimated the strength of your beetle-battler sixth sense is all!

727300430.text: Huh? So that's the kid Itto lost to? Yeah, he does look pretty normal...

727300431.text: But the way he talks is pretty unique. It almost feels like... he was born to be Bull-Chucker's archnemesis!

727300501.text: What a puny opponent... And what a garish Onikabuto...

727300502.text: Pathetic! You can paint your Onikabuto any color you want... the only thing that counts in battle is their Electro affinity — the source of their power.

727300503.text: Being able to pick out a prize Onikabuto from the crowd is all that matters. That's what makes or breaks every beetle-fighter!

727300504.text: That's a strange theory... Even Paimon knows that performance in battle matters the most. Honing your beetle-fighting skills is the most important thing!

727300506.text: Nice-sounding theory, but it ain't gonna help you if you don't know how to fight!

727300507.text: Listen up, White-Iron Lavender Melon. You need to watch your opponent's Onikabuto closely, so you can dodge its attacks. Then, in the opening right afterward, you strike back!

727300508.text: As long as the opponent is in range, Crimson Staff will hit 'em hard!

727300509.text: Got it! So when the opponent attacks, we get our Onikabuto to retreat, and when there's an opening, we move it forward and strike while they're still recovering!

727300510.text: #Sounds simple enough. Paimon will give it a go! {NICKNAME} heard the explanation too, so Paimon bets we're both ready for battle!

727300511.text: Are you seriously learning beetle fighting right before a match? You underestimate who you're up against!

727300512.text: Enough talk. Put your Onikabuto on the table and show me what you've got!

727300601.text: Hehe, piece of cake! You don't mess with this White-Iron Lavender Melon!

727300603.text: Whoa! Who-ho-ho-hoa! Pretty talented, ain'cha? You sure showed them who's boss!

727300604.text: You, my little friend, have earned yourself an Egg Roll later today.

727300607.text: Ah, "Grandmaster Hanakado," I lost to a complete novice... I have let you down!

727300608.text: Don't worry. It seems that they are a force to be reckoned with... We should inform the other generals to prepare for battle.

727300609.text: You defy my expectations once again, Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King... I didn't expect you to find such formidable warriors so quickly.

727300610.text: From today onward, I will send one of my generals here daily to face you.

727300611.text: Be sure that you survive until the final battle. Otherwise, your declaration of war will become the laughingstock of the entire beetle-fighting world.

727300612.text: Wait just a minute. Leaving so soon? What are you, scared?

727300613.text: Gah, he's so annoying. Turning up here uninvited, talking to us in that smug tone, then taking off before we're done with him...

727300614.text: From what Grandmaster Hanakado said, seems like he's gonna send some of his minions to challenge us. Guess we'll have another battle before too long, huh?

727300615.text: That's right. Looks like we won't have time to make the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl the grandest event ever organized by the Arataki Gang...

727300616.text: Meh, works for me! An audience would've been sweet, but at the end of the day, we came here to battle, and battling is what we're gonna do!

727300617.text: Look at you, Flying... ahem! Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon... defeating your first powerful enemy, starting to make a name for yourself as a fighter... Really gets me into the fighting spirit!

727300618.text: Gets me thinking about myself, back in the day, when I first entered the Hanamizaka beetle-battling scene... taking on the pros for the first time...
